sloka: उवाच च शुभं वाक्यं कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम् ।प्रीतो ऽस्मि परितुष्टो ऽस्मि तवाद्य वचने ऽनघ ।। ७.८३.१७ ॥
transliteration: uvāca ca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ kaikeyyānandavardhanam ।prīto 'smi parituṣṭo 'smi tavādya vacane 'nagha ।। 7.83.17 ॥

translations.english: And he spoke auspicious words that increased Kaikeyi's joy, saying, "O sinless one, I am pleased and completely satisfied with your words today."
